mentions.name: Steno
mentions.description: This app records a small multi-person in-person meeting and transcribes the audio into meeting notes using only local LLMs, keeping the data off the cloud entirely. It ships as a single download that runs on MacOS, Windows and Linux and handles both recording and transcription.
mentions.problem: Recording a room on Android and getting good meeting notes (in Norwegian) from the audio is tricky when using only local LLMs and avoiding the data touching the cloud at any point.
mentions.audience: Volunteers who run small in-person meetings
mentions.source_excerpt:
But I have a wip single download app that lets one record and transcribe - should work on MacOS (tested), Windows (not yet tested), Linux (tested on chromeOS/Terminal).

The UI is a vibecoded mess:

https://hypertekst.net/steno/
